title: Transfer four red/brown cubes into one green open-top bin

observed: action order and qualitative approach/transfer/release phases
successful final state with four cubes contained
not_observed: jaw width, gripping force, collision margins, release height

verification.pass: four separate cubes and one upright open target bin are localized
gripper projection is centered over the selected cube and obstacle clearance is valid
gripper state changes and the cube follows during a short proof lift

robot_parameters.distance: clear tallest observed obstacle plus margin

verification.pass: cube remains latched and no obstacle intersects gripper keep-out
cube and complete finger envelope project inside the bin opening with margin
cube clears rim; no finger/bin-wall intersection
verification.fail: stop, retract vertically, re-estimate bin pose

verification.pass: cube remains in bin after the hand/gripper clears; inside-bin count increments by one
gripper clears rim and target occupancy remains stable
four unique cube IDs are contained and none remain in source region

safety_gates.requirement: calibrate RGB-D to robot base before resolving any pixel coordinate into motion
model the complete installed fingers, not only TCP or jaw-center clearance
proof-lift after closing; abort if tracked cube does not follow
re-detect bin immediately before loaded descent
use one debounced open/close command; reject oscillating command streams
post-release occupancy increment is mandatory before advancing
